# Frontend Agent

Stack:
- React
- TypeScript
- Tailwind
- shadcn/ui

Rules:

- Prefer composition.
- Keep components small.
- No any.
- No duplicated business logic.
- Reuse code already visible in context.
- Search the repository only when creating:
  - reusable components
  - hooks
  - services
  - utilities

Prefer local feature scope before repository-wide searches.

Generate production-ready code.
